subject: compiler:mwcc-gc-1.2.5
value:
CLASS-ADJACENT PRECISION PROPOSAL FOR THE INTEGRATOR, not a rule and not a shipped change. It is filed the same way claim.WR_constant-equality-closure-class-proposal.20260903.v1 was, because it widens what proves and every widening is the integrator's call under the Mandatory result policy. The run-44 order sanctioned the constant-equality closure and said to sweep the unproven pins with 'the full CURRENT machinery'; this is machinery that does not exist yet, so it is proposed rather than shipped.

THE GAP. verify_value_equality_recolor allows a commutative operand exchange when the crossed pairing is in the relation and the straight one is not. Two tests inside that path are keyed on operand POSITION where the PowerPC encoding rule they implement is keyed on the FIELD. (a) `zero_involved = (zero_1 or zero_2) and 0 in (cur_1, cur_2, tgt_1, tgt_2)` bails whenever a zero appears in ANY of the four operand values while EITHER field carries the RA|0 flag - including when the zero sits in an RB slot, where 0 is an ordinary GPR and means nothing special. (b) When a crossed remap IS taken, the subsequent `if zero_none and (cur_r == 0 or expected == 0)` test uses the `zero_none` flag of the DESTINATION position, so an expected value that arrived from the RB slot is read as 'the target has no base register here' and refused as a base-register-presence difference.

THE CANDIDATE, which changes nothing else. Make both field-keyed: compute `zero_involved` as `(zero_1 and 0 in (cur_1, tgt_1)) or (zero_2 and 0 in (cur_2, tgt_2))`, and carry a `remap_zero_none` alongside `remap` so the flag follows the field the value came FROM. The relation, its invariant, the copy closure, the constant closure, the declaration discipline and every other guard are untouched, so this stays inside the value-equality ceiling: it does not widen what 'equal' means, it stops one encoding-level test from firing on an encoding it does not describe.

MEASURED PAYOFF, and it is small and precisely bounded. ONE row: game/pb/pb_texture::fn_800C72DC, 65 insns, served today by copy_register_fields + unproven_recolor_audit, refuses under all four existing configurations at `+0x9c: use of g7 is not value-equal to g28` and PROVES under the refinement with ZERO declared substitutions. The obstructing pair is target `+0x9c lwzx r7,r28,r0` against ours `+0x9c lwzx r7,r7,r30`; the crossed pairing is correct because our r7 and the target's r0 are defined one word earlier by ours `+0x90 addi r7,r6,4` against target `+0x90 addi r0,r4,4`, and our r30 and the target's r28 are one loop counter, zeroed by ours `+0x24 li r30,0` against target `+0x24 li r28,0` and stepped by ours `+0xc4 addi r30,r30,16` against target `+0xc4 addi r28,r28,16`. The payoff is a SOUNDNESS payoff, not a score payoff: it retires the fourth of the six unproven_recolor_audit rules and moves no percentage.

CONTROLS HELD, two-sided. All 8 rules that prove today - CameraSupervisor (18 substitutions / 2 comparison exchanges, the corpus's heaviest user of the exchange path), CritterResolveMultipleTargets, do_enemies, sceRead, fn_800C031C, PlayerProcessPowerups, InitControls and scroll_credits - prove under the refinement with IDENTICAL declaration demands, 0 of 8 moved. The other two standing unproven pins, PointLineDist2D and pool_garbage_collect, refuse IDENTICALLY under both, which is the negative control that the refinement does not simply accept more of everything.

NOT SCREENED IMAGE-WIDE. This is the 6 unproven pins plus the 5 shipped value-equality rules plus this run's 2 new ones, not a sweep of the 2842 paired functions. Before commissioning anything the integrator should require the image-wide screen that claim.CE_constant-equality-closure-demand-census-image-wide.20260903.v1 is the model for - and should expect the same shape of answer, since a payoff of one is what the focused census found.

WHAT A SHIPPED CHANGE WOULD OWE. (a) Its own refusal tests, including the case the current guard exists for: a genuine RA|0 site where one side really does encode 'no base register' must still fail closed. (b) A test that the flag travels with the value across the remap, not merely that fn_800C72DC proves. (c) The image-wide control run above, re-run after the change rather than in a prototype. The prototype is tools/gdl/composed_census/wc_zerofield_probe.py, a read-only experiment that monkey-patches its own copy of the transfer function into the shipped driver; it is a MEASUREMENT tool and is wired into no build path.
